q: Meanwhile the English passion for gravy led to the belief in an illusory substance called ozmazome, a kind of El Dorado of juicy nourishment thought to lie at the heart of the meat — a befuddled concept from which the German chemist Justus von Leibig nevertheless made a great deal of money when he invented beef extract.
